product.description: Monoprice™8K DisplayPort® 2.0 CableSupports up to 16K resolution with up to 120Hz refresh rateDisplayPort® 2.0 cables are perfect for maximizing your current setup, while ensuring your cables are ready for future hardware upgrades. DisplayPort 2.0 supports up to 16K resolution with higher refresh rates, thanks to nearly triple the total bandwidth to 80.0Gbps, over the 32.4Gbps of DisplayPort 1.4a. For single screens, it handles a hefty 16K resolution with HDR at 60Hz and up to 30 bits per pixel (30bpp) color depth.DisplayPort® 2.0 provides great performance for dual monitor setups, as well. For example, you can run two displays with 8K resolution and HDR at 120Hz with 30bpp using Display Stream Compression (DSC). These cables enable audio and video transmissions with Display Stream compression (DSC), HDR at 60Hz, up to 30 bits per pixel (30bpp) color depth, and Forward Error Correction.Supports up to 16K resolutionSupports up to 120Hz refresh rateSupports HDR10 with 30bpp deep color and YCbCr 4:4:4 color spaceSupports NVIDIA® G‑Sync® AMD® FreeSync™Up to 80.0Gbps bandwidth, nearly triple that of DP 1.4aBackward compatible with DisplayPort® 1.2 and 1.4 devicesSupports Display Stream Compression (DSC)Supports Multi‑Stream Transport (MST) EXCEPTIONAL CLARITY AND PERFORMANCEWith single display support for resolutions up to 16K@60Hz with support for HDR10 and 30bpp color depth, you can enjoy exceptional clarity and performance. GET THE BEST PERFORMANCE FROM YOUR MULTIPLE MONITOR SETUPEnjoy fantastic performance in multiple monitor configurations, with resolutions up to 8K@120Hz with HDR10 and 30bpp color depth using Display Stream Compression (DSC) for two displays. FREESYNC AND G‑SYNC COMPATIBLEThese cables support AMD® FreeSync™ and NVIDIA® G‑Sync® adaptive sync technologies to enjoy smooth, tear‑free gaming and movie watching at the highest frame rates and refresh rates. ALMOST TRIPLE THE BANDWIDTHDisplayPort® 2.0 supports a total bandwidth of 80.0Gbps, almost triple that of the 32.4Gbps of DisplayPort 1.4.
